works.body:
Nice to meet you. I've seen your work on Twitter before, and I've been wanting to ask you for an illustration.
This time, I would like to request an illustration of my own character as a Vtuber.
I'm a Japanese wolf, a university student in the information field who is busy with assignments, and I mainly do work streaming with typing sounds.

The purpose of the character is to be attached to tweets on Twitter, and to be posted on other SNS. If it is possible to insert the character into a video thumbnail or a schedule, I would appreciate it if you could provide me with a transparent file or a psd file with separate layers for the character only. You will be credited in each place of use.

I don't have any other requests (composition, etc.). I love your work, so I would be happy if you could draw freely.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to working with you.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Wt741-ORCzgJJJnjAk0bZi2zKLObf2l7?usp=sharing

Hello! You have a cute style and I’d like to see my cute prince in it! You can choose the outfit you like and the pose as well, as for the background it can be a rainy day on the beach.
